name: Splashtop
summary: Splashtop sells remote access to a person's own computers and a separate remote support product for technicians. Business Access starts at $99 per user per year for the Pro plan, which adds session recording and role-based access. The Enterprise plan is quoted and adds single sign-on and SIEM logging. Splashtop states ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 and GDPR compliance on its security page.

facts.text: Splashtop's Pro plan and above include session recording, and the Enterprise plan adds SIEM logging and cloud recording.
Single sign-on is listed on the Enterprise plan, which is priced by quote.
Splashtop says remote sessions use TLS and 256-bit AES encryption, and that two-factor authentication on endpoint devices is optional.
Splashtop says it is compliant with ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, GDPR and CCPA, and that it supports HIPAA, PCI and FERPA needs.
The Remote Support SOS product is licensed per concurrent technician rather than per user.

plans.name: Solo
plans.notes: Listed as $6 a month, billed annually at $72.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Listed as $8.25 a month per user, billed annually. Adds session recording and user role and access management.

plans.name: Performance
plans.notes: Listed as $13 a month per user, billed annually. Adds higher video quality and USB passthrough.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Adds single sign-on, SIEM logging and cloud recording.

plans.name: Remote Support SOS
plans.notes: Listed as starting at $22 a month per concurrent technician, billed annually at $259 or $399. The page does not say which amount applies to which option.

hiddenCosts: Single sign-on, SIEM logging and cloud recording are only on the quoted Enterprise plan.
A free trial is offered on every plan, but the pricing page does not state its length.
